title: The password
starting_code: # The password is ambrel. Say it, and walk through!
hints: You need to make your wizard say the password first.
Use the `say` method to speak, and then walk up the path.
The gate listens for the string "ambrel".
intro: An older pupil told me the password, *ambrel*. Say it, and walk through, six steps up the path beyond!
outro: It opened! A string was exactly what the gate was listening for.
learned: Now you know what a string is, and how to make your wizard say things.
